# Authentic experiment records

`reimagined-interval-cue-r1.json` is an exact copy of the retained saved plan at
`dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/reimagined-interval-cue-parent-r1/plan.json`.
SHA-256: `c55e1452f035911e1faf85066a6753159c77818aec3b2af08ee4735482721216`.
Its null pre-supervision deadline and stale Photon sourceReview are intentionally
unchanged regression inputs, not valid new-launch admission.

`reimagined-control-receipt-fields-r1.json` projects only the static fields used
by the checker from the actual named ControlCaptureReceipt JSON in that run.
Original complete receipt SHA-256: `077b77145b4117479b61c57cf1eb52e0cf0e397484d32ca9e53c79ac973d08f8`.
Projection preserves exact values, including the 399-option map and real
`saved-observations` status. It establishes historical schema coverage, not a
new rendering or work-reuse check. Raw captures/logs remain ignored.

Tests relocate paths and create tiny dependent stand-ins in temporary directories;
these are deliberately not Minecraft worlds, real driver inputs or speed evidence.
